title: JNI ERROR: local reference table overflow (max=512)
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.5 beta 5
- Reproducible in 4.4.1 stable

### System information

Linux Fedora 42

### Issue description

App crashes on Android 7 (I am using emulator) when calling `decorView.setBackgroundColor(Color.RED.to_argb32())`.

### Steps to reproduce

Just call this method:

```
func _on_button_pressed() -> void:
	var android_runtime = Engine.get_singleton("AndroidRuntime")
	var activity = android_runtime.getActivity()
	var callable = func ():
		var decorView = activity.getWindow().getDecorView()
		decorView.setBackgroundColor(Color.RED.to_argb32())
	
	activity.runOnUiThread(android_runtime.createRunnableFromGodotCallable(callable))
```
